copy.text: My finances are scattered across too many apps

scenes.why: Search-led placements reward the exact words someone typed; quoted, it reads as their thought, not our claim.

caption.text: One place holding accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt and savings, with a single figure for what is actually available.

scenes.why: The answer, shown working on the real screen it happens on. Screen: "Records" (What's actually true right now, area by area: accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "One place holding accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt and"; focus on "Accounts".

caption.text: See what's actually available to spend

scenes.why: A second, related thing an owner does here, so it reads as a tool, not a single trick. Screen: "Printable Finance Companion" (The paper version: printable finance companion in US Letter and A4, and a shared responsibility statement.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "See what's actually available to spend"; focus on "Printable Finance Companion".
Named at the end, once the idea has earned the save.
TikTok punishes an obvious ad; a soft close names the product and where to find it.

reasoning.because: Native, fast and plain-spoken; polish that looks like an ad gets skipped. Sound-on. Hook inside a second. The deepest bottom and right overlays of any placement.

reasoning.because: From its definition and Shop listing. 4 real screens to show.

reasoning.decision: You have more than one account, bill, or income source and want them tracked in one real place, not five apps. / You want a next step handed to you, not a dashboard you have to interpret yourself every time.
reasoning.because: The listing's own audience lines; the director writes for them.

reasoning.decision: In their words: Lead with a phrase people actually search, then show the real screen that answers it.
reasoning.because: Best fit for a awareness film on TikTok (platform fit 2, goal fit 3). Other candidates: Problem cascade (4.1), Before and after (3.7).

reasoning.decision: "My finances are scattered across too many apps"
reasoning.because: A searched phrase, "My finances are scattered across too many apps", and the listing's own answer to it.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab. TikTok wants native editing, so hard cuts and whips lead.
Camera "dolly": constant forward movement for a high-energy feed.
Grounds light → accent → light → ink: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on TikTok (0.24s a word), inside 10–22s.
